items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: we had, at the time the trumpeter was Bobby Williams and Bobby would bring in compositions, he would bring in arrangements, we actually rehearsed.

ctx.x: Because those guys played from a different experience.

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, and that’s where I mean the band today is a little bit amorphous because we don’t quite have a focus because everybody’s got his own idea of what it should sound like. And I mean when I — in the 80s — had musicians, all of whom had played the Savoy Ballroom, I mean you know we had, at the time the trumpeter was Bobby Williams and Bobby would bring in compositions, he would bring in arrangements, we actually rehearsed. Because Bobby was so interested in having it come out right. That spirit is…
What would cause you to stop doing this?
